item.title: If you own a Nasdaq-100 fund, you’ll own Anthropic shares after 15 trading days — whether you want to or not
item.description: Anthropic’s suppliers are buying $26 billion worth of stock at the IPO price because they want to. Some funds will be forced to buy, and at a potentially worse price.
